# Private Academy - Full Knowledge Base & Platform Guide

Website: https://www.privateacademy.in
Publisher: Private Academy Engineering
Founder / Lead Engineer: Karan Gholap (https://www.karangholap.com/)

---

## 1. Platform Overview & Purpose
Private Academy is an open, high-quality academic platform built specifically for engineering undergraduates in India. It addresses the gap in syllabus-aligned study materials by providing curated lecture notes, solved semester question banks, project source code, and educational video guides.

### Key Value Propositions
- **Syllabus-Aligned:** Content strictly structured around university curricula (Mumbai University Rev-2019/C-Scheme, SPPU 2019 Pattern, DBATU).
- **Free & Accessible:** Core study notes and question guides are accessible to all engineering students without paywalls.
- **Peer & Community Contributed:** Verified notes uploaded by top-performing students and subject matter experts.
- **Hands-on Projects:** Mini and micro projects complete with source code, setup documentation, and live demo links.

---

## 2. Core Modules & Content Specifications

### A. Engineering Notes Library (`/notes`)
- **Branches Supported:** Computer Engineering, Information Technology (IT), Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (AI-DS), Electronics & Telecommunication (EXTC).
- **Semesters Covered:** Semester 1 to Semester 8.
- **Content Types:** PDF study notes, module-wise summaries, formula sheets, previous year solved question papers (PYQs), and video walkthrough links.

### B. Technical & Educational Articles (`/articles`)
- **Topics:** Detailed subject explanations (e.g., Applied Mathematics, Data Structures, Database Systems, Computer Networks, Operating Systems, Web Development).
- **Exam Preparation Guides:** Scoring strategies, key question breakdowns, and syllabus roadmap guides for university end-sem exams.

### C. Student Micro & Mini Projects (`/projects`)
- **Domains:** Full-Stack Web Apps, Mobile Development, Python & Data Science, Machine Learning models, Internet of Things (IoT).
- **Deliverables:** Full GitHub repository links, setup guides, documentation, and live preview links.

### D. Community Discussions (`/discussions`)
- **Function:** Doubt-solving portal where students post specific exam questions, code bugs, or concept queries and receive verified answers from peers and admins.

---

## 3. Structural Schemas & Machine Readability
Private Academy uses standard JSON-LD Schema.org specifications across all pages:
- `EducationalOrganization` & `WebSite` schemas on the root layout.
- `LearningResource` schema on study note pages.
- `TechArticle` schema on academic articles.
- `ItemList` & `SoftwareSourceCode` schemas on project listings.
